easy.explanation: The text says Samson went down to Timnath.
easy.q: Where did Samson go down to?

answers: A woman of the daughters of Israel
A woman of the daughters of the Philistines
The wife of one of his companions
easy.explanation: Samson saw a woman of the daughters of the Philistines.
easy.q: Whom did Samson see in Timnath?

answers: Get the woman for him to wife
easy.explanation: Samson asked them to get her for him to wife.
easy.q: What did Samson ask his parents to do?

answers: She was one of the uncircumcised Philistines
medium.explanation: They questioned why he would take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines.
medium.q: Why did Samson’s parents object to his choice?

medium.explanation: Samson said, “for she pleaseth me well.”
medium.q: Why did Samson say he wanted this woman?

medium.explanation: Samson sought an occasion, or opportunity, against the Philistines.
medium.q: In this passage, what does “occasion” mean?

answers: It became an opportunity for conflict with the Philistines
It caused Samson to leave Israel
challenge.explanation: The passage says Samson’s desire provided an occasion against the Philistines.
challenge.q: How was Samson’s desire connected with God’s providence?

answers: They knew not that it was of the Lord
They did not know where Timnath was
They did not know who the Philistines were
challenge.explanation: The text expressly says they knew not that it was of the Lord.
challenge.q: What detail shows that Samson’s parents did not understand the larger purpose?

challenge.explanation: The passage says the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
challenge.q: What was the political condition of the Philistines at that time?

paragraphs.title: The Lion, the Honey, and Samson’s Secret

easy.explanation: A young lion roared against Samson.
easy.q: What animal met Samson on the way to Timnath?

easy.explanation: Samson rent the lion as he would have rent a kid.
easy.q: What did Samson do to the lion?

easy.explanation: He found a swarm of bees and honey in the carcass.
easy.q: What did Samson find in the lion’s carcass?

medium.explanation: The Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon Samson.
medium.q: What enabled Samson to overcome the lion?

answers: He ate it and gave some to his parents
He hid it in the lion’s carcass
medium.explanation: He took the honey, ate it, and gave some to his parents.
medium.q: What did Samson do with the honey?

answers: The honey was found in their house
medium.explanation: Samson told them not that he had taken the honey from the carcass.
medium.q: Why did Samson’s parents not know where the honey came from?

answers: The lion and the honey became the basis of the riddle
The lion guarded the thirty garments
The lion was one of Samson’s companions
challenge.explanation: The riddle depended on meat coming from the eater and sweetness coming from the strong.
challenge.q: How was the lion connected with Samson’s riddle?

answers: He did not tell his parents about the lion or the honey’s source
He told everyone in the city
He wrote it on his garments
challenge.explanation: Samson concealed both what he had done to the lion and where the honey came from.

answers: He took honey in his hands
He knocked the lion to the ground
He led his parents to Timnath
challenge.explanation: The phrase refers to Samson taking honey from the carcass.
challenge.q: What does “he took thereof in his hands” refer to?

paragraphs.title: The Wedding Feast and the Riddle

easy.explanation: The text says Samson made a feast there.
easy.q: What did Samson make in Timnath?

easy.explanation: Thirty companions were brought to be with him.
easy.q: How many companions were brought to Samson?

easy.explanation: Samson said he would put forth a riddle.
easy.q: What did Samson present to his companions?

answers: The seven days of the feast
medium.explanation: They had to declare it within the seven days of the feast.
medium.q: How long did the companions have to solve the riddle?

answers: Thirty sheets and thirty change of garments
medium.explanation: That was the reward Samson promised.
medium.q: What would the companions receive if they solved the riddle?

medium.explanation: The phrase refers to garments supplied as clothing.

challenge.explanation: The riddle came from the event involving honey in the lion’s carcass.
challenge.q: What was Samson’s riddle based on?

answers: They would give Samson thirty sheets and thirty change of garments
They would immediately leave the feast
They would bring him a lion
challenge.explanation: If they could not declare it, they had to give Samson the garments.
challenge.q: What would happen if the companions could not solve the riddle?

answers: It was based on a secret they did not know
It was spoken in a foreign language
challenge.explanation: The riddle depended on Samson’s secret encounter with the lion and honey.
challenge.q: Why was the riddle difficult for the companions?

paragraphs.title: The Threat, the Revealed Riddle, and the Response

easy.explanation: They told Samson’s wife to entice her husband.
easy.q: Whom did Samson’s companions ask to entice?

answers: Burn her and her father’s house with fire
easy.explanation: They threatened to burn her and her father’s house.
easy.q: What did the companions threaten to do to Samson’s wife?

easy.explanation: She told the riddle to the children of her people.
easy.q: To whom did Samson’s wife reveal the riddle?

answers: She wept and said that he hated her
medium.explanation: She wept and accused Samson of hating her and not loving her.
medium.q: How did Samson’s wife try to make him reveal the riddle?

answers: He had not told it even to his father or mother
He had already told it to the companions
medium.explanation: Samson said he had not told it to his father or mother.
medium.q: What did Samson first say about keeping the riddle secret?

medium.explanation: The companions wanted her to persuade Samson to reveal the riddle.
medium.q: In this passage, what does “entice” mean?

answers: She pressed him during all seven days of the feast
challenge.explanation: He told her because she lay sore upon him during the feast.
challenge.q: What finally caused Samson to tell his wife the riddle?

answers: They received the answer through Samson’s wife
challenge.explanation: Samson knew they had learned the answer through his wife.
challenge.q: What does the men’s answer reveal about how they solved the riddle?

answers: They had used his wife to obtain the answer
They had invited him to the feast
challenge.explanation: Samson meant that they had used his wife to discover the riddle’s answer.
challenge.q: What did Samson mean by “If ye had not plowed with my heifer”?

paragraphs.title: Ashkelon, the Garments, and the Broken Marriage

easy.explanation: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson.
easy.q: What came mightily upon Samson after the riddle was solved?

answers: He gave them to those who expounded the riddle
He returned them to his wife
He gave them to his parents
easy.explanation: He gave the change of garments to the men who explained the riddle.
easy.q: What did Samson do with the garments?

answers: The riddle had been solved through his wife
medium.explanation: Samson realized that his wife had helped them obtain the answer.

answers: He went up to his father’s house
medium.explanation: After his anger was kindled, he went up to his father’s house.
medium.q: What did Samson do after giving the garments?

answers: She was given to his companion
She went to her father’s house
medium.explanation: She was given to Samson’s companion.
medium.q: What happened to Samson’s wife after he left?

answers: He obtained garments to pay the promised debt
He found the answer to the riddle there
He invited the thirty companions from there
challenge.explanation: He took the garments of the slain men and gave them to those who solved the riddle.
challenge.q: How did Samson’s action in Ashkelon fulfill the terms of the riddle?

answers: His anger and withdrawal from the feast
His desire to continue the marriage
challenge.explanation: The text connects his departure to the kindling of his anger.
challenge.q: What does Samson’s return to his father’s house emphasize?

answers: Samson paid the wager and left in anger
Samson remained with his wife at the feast
The companions paid Samson the garments
challenge.explanation: Samson obtained the garments, gave them as payment, became angry, and left.
challenge.q: What result followed the revealing of the riddle?
